danger.purpose: Genuine errors and destructive actions only — form errors, delete.

success.purpose: A completed state — اكتملت, all-done band, saved confirmation. Distinct from primary: says 'finished', not 'act here'.

warning.purpose: 'Not started yet' and unresolved states — pending pills, pending chips, merge frame. A to-do, never an error.

body.purpose: Running text, dialog messages, announcement bodies. The only weight-400 role.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, table headers, date-chip value. Weight 700 even at 13px.

caption.purpose: Status pills, chips, timestamps, <small>, period toggles. Weight 700 at 12px.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow on cards, top bar, date chip, widgets. Barely-there separation from the ground.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Hover / focus on an interactive card only — never a resting state.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Modals and the confirm dialog, at rest — the one deliberate resting-shadow exception.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring (--primary-tint). Replaces the outline on fields.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Default transition duration (card lift, modal in).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve. prefers-reduced-motion collapses all durations to ~0.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard widgets go from a 2-column grid to 1 column at or below this width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single 'do this next' control in a card or action group. Solid Pharmacy Green.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 10px 18px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; background: var(--primary, #087c54); color: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs, 0 1px 2px #0f2f2410); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), transform .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #08543b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #087c54); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default weight for 'another thing you can do here'. Green-50 ground, green-200 border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--green-200, #b2d8c6); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 10px 18px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; background: var(--green-50, #eef6f1); color: var(--primary-hover, #08543b); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), transform .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--green-100, #d9ece1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #087c54); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The quietest tier — an optional/secondary path that must not compete before it is relevant (e.g. الجارت الإضافي before the ward has started).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #b9cdc2); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 10px 18px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #4f6b63); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-alt, #f0f5f2); border-color: var(--green-300, #7fbfa4); color: var(--primary-hover, #08543b); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #087c54); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field. 1px strong-hairline border, custom focus ring instead of an outline.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #b9cdc2); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #132a27); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 9px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow .14s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #4f6b63); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #087c54); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-tint, #087c541f); }

components.name: Interactive Location Card
components.description: Signature picker card. The whole card is the click target; it lifts and its trailing chevron slides on hover/focus. A card whose buttons do the work stays flat instead.
components.css: .ds-card-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dbe6df); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #132a27); text-align: start; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs, 0 1px 2px #0f2f2410); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-card-link:hover, .ds-card-link:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--green-300, #7fbfa4); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 2px 8px #12332612); outline: none; } .ds-card-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); background: var(--green-100, #d9ece1); color: var(--primary, #087c54); font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; } .ds-card-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-body strong { display: block; color: var(--heading, #064d3e); } .ds-card-body small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-muted, #4f6b63); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-chev { margin-inline-start: auto; display: flex; color: var(--primary, #087c54); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-card-link:hover .ds-card-chev, .ds-card-link:focus-visible .ds-card-chev { transform: translateX(-3px); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Worded ward/floor status. Colour reinforces the word, never replaces it. Variants: pending (amber, 'not started'), partial (green tint, '2/3'), done (green + check, 'اكتملت'), muted ('data unavailable').
components.html: اكتملت لم تبدأ 2/3
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status svg { flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-status--pending { background: var(--warning-tint, #a8640016); color: var(--warning, #a86400); } .ds-status--partial { background: var(--green-100, #d9ece1); color: var(--primary-hover, #08543b); } .ds-status--done { background: var(--success-tint, #0a7d5116); color: var(--success, #0a7d51); } .ds-status--muted { background: var(--surface-alt, #f0f5f2); color: var(--text-muted, #4f6b63); }

components.name: Modal / Alert Dialog
components.description: Medicine registration and the window.confirm replacement. Deep-green backdrop wash; card carries --shadow-md at rest (the one resting-shadow exception).
components.html:

حذف هذا الإعلان؟
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: #062b21a8; } .ds-modal { position: relative; width: min(100%, 420px); padding: 40px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 14px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md, 0 12px 32px #12332618); } .ds-modal-kicker { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--text-muted, #4f6b63); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-modal-msg { margin: 0 0 32px; color: var(--text, #132a27); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; } .ds-btn-danger { border: 1px solid #e6b8bb; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; background: var(--danger-tint, #c92a3316); color: var(--danger, #c92a33); cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
This is the paper medication chart, digitized — and it earns its place by being faster than paper, never by being prettier than it. The whole system is calm and clinical: a soft green-tinted ground, one 10-step green ramp doing almost all the work, hairline borders, and text that stays legible for a tired pharmacist reading a shared tablet at 6am under ward lighting, sometimes through a glove. Nothing is decorative. Every surface is either a control, a value, or the structure that holds them.

Density is moderate, not cramped: generous line-height on running text (1.65), real gaps between groups, touch targets sized for a gloved thumb (44px on anything you press). The palette is quiet by design — the strong greens (500–800) are reserved for headings, primary actions, and the one 'do this next' button per card; everything else lives in the 50–200 tints and the neutral surfaces. Colour never carries meaning alone: a status is always a word or an icon first (بدأت / لم تبدأ / اكتملت), with hue as a second channel.

The interface is bilingual-script but Arabic-first and fully RTL. It uses logical properties throughout (margin-inline-start, padding-inline) so the one place a physical direction appears — the progress-bar fill origin — is a deliberate, commented exception. There is a full dark theme, toggled on <html data-theme="dark">, that overrides only the semantic tokens (surfaces, text, intents, the top three green steps, shadows) and leaves structure untouched.
keyCharacteristics: One brand hue (Pharmacy Green #087c54) with a 10-step ramp; no secondary or tertiary accent.
Flat by default; a raised shadow is a response to interaction, not a resting state.
Worded status over colour-coded status, always — a shared-device / glare / gloves constraint.
Restrained components: 6–14px radii, 1px borders, quiet state changes (colour, border, a 1px press).
Arabic RTL, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, logical properties, full dark theme.
The printed A4 chart is a first-class output; its @media print CSS is frozen.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one brand colour. If a screen seems to need a second accent, it needs better hierarchy in the green ramp instead — not a new hue.

rules.name: The Worded-Status Rule
rules.body: Every status is a word or an icon first (بدأت, لم تبدأ, اكتملت, تعذّر…), with colour as reinforcement. A pill that would carry meaning by hue alone is incomplete.

rules.name: The Red-Means-Error Rule
rules.body: danger / red is reserved for real errors and destructive actions. Not counts, not emphasis, not 'overdue'.

rules.name: The Bold-Label Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, chips and table headers are weight 700 even at 12–13px — small text in this tool is functional and must not recede. Body copy is the only thing set at 400.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If an element has a shadow bigger than --shadow-xs and it is not a modal, it must be because the user is interacting with it right now. Remove the hover and the shadow goes back to hairline.

rules.name: The Radius-By-Size Rule
rules.body: Radius tracks the element's size, not its importance: small controls get 6px, mid 10px, large panels 14px, and only truly pill-shaped elements get 999px.

dos: Do build every new colour need out of the existing green ramp (green-50…green-900) plus the three intents. One hue.
Do give every status a word or icon; use colour only to reinforce it (.card-status pattern).
Do keep surfaces flat (1px border + --shadow-xs); add --shadow-sm only as a hover/focus response on something interactive.
Do use exactly one solid --primary button per card or action group — the 'do this next' control.
Do use logical properties (margin-inline-*, padding-inline, text-align: start) so RTL is automatic; if you must use a physical direction, comment why.
Do size anything pressable for a gloved thumb — min-height: 44px on buttons and chips in the working screens.
Do carry the hospital identity (name + logo) on screens and every printed chart.
Do provide a dark-theme value for any new semantic token (surface/text/intent), not for structural ones.
donts: Don't touch the @media print blocks for the chart or the pill form. That layout is frozen; change it only on explicit request and verify with headless Chrome.
Don't use danger / red for anything that isn't a genuine error or a destructive action — not counts, not emphasis, not 'overdue'.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or a display/serif typeface — there is no hero moment in this tool.
Don't give a card a hover-lift unless the whole card is the click target.
Don't translate, abbreviate, or 'correct' the Arabic clinical vocabulary (جارت، الجارت الإضافي، ردهة، الحبوب، بدأت/لم تبدأ/اكتملت).
Don't rely on shadows for depth where a border or a tonal step (surface vs surface-alt) will do.
